latest_release.name: FastDFS 6.18.1 released
latest_release.body:
FastDFS v6.18.0 and v6.18.1 have been released, mainly featuring minor improvements and fixes for potential security vulnerabilities.

tracker.conf supports configuring the tracker server list. It is necessary to set static_tracker_servers to true. It is recommended to include the tracker server list file through the #include directive. Both storage.conf and client.conf include this list file through the #include directive, for example:
`#include tracker_servers.conf`

The configuration items storage_sync_file_max_delay and storage_sync_file_max_time in tracker.conf support specifying time units, with the default time unit second. For example, m represents minutes (such as 5m for 5 minutes), d represents days (such as 1d for 1 day), and so on.

The functions storage_sync_rename_file and storage_sync_link_file have addressed the buffer overflow vulnerability reported by Akhil Koul (by simply checking the length of the received file name).

The detailed change log is as follows:
```
Version 6.18.1  2026-09-12
 * storage_sync_rename_file and storage_sync_link_file:
   fix stack buffer overflow reported by Akhil Koul

Version 6.18.0  2026-09-04
 * tracker.conf support static tracker servers
 * tracker.conf: storage_sync_file_max_delay and storage_sync_file_max_time
   support time unit as m for minute, d for day etc. such as 10m, 1d
 * use libfastcommon V1.88 and libserverframe 1.2.15
```
